AdminOverviewController
Admin REST endpoint exposing aggregate system statistics under /api/admin.

AdminOverviewResponse.ComponentHealth
Health status (status/detail) of one system component.

A role definition (name plus human-readable description).
AdminOverviewResponse.SystemMetrics

AdminOverviewResponse.UserSummary

AdminOverviewService
Assembles the administrator dashboard overview: the Keycloak user/role directory, aggregate document and folder counts, a summary of the permission scopes, and live health of the backing components (Keycloak, MongoDB).
ApiException

AuthInfoController
Returns the currently authenticated user's identity and roles extracted from the Keycloak JWT.
BreadcrumbEntry
One node in a folder breadcrumb trail: the folder id and its display name.

CmisException
A CMIS fault carrying the fault type used to render the JSON error body.

CmisFault
The subset of CMIS exceptions this MVP raises, each paired with the HTTP status the CMIS Browser binding maps it to.
CmisObjects
Builds CMIS Browser-binding JSON for DMS objects and parses incoming property arrays.
CmisService
CMIS 1.1 operations (Browser/JSON binding) over the DMS data model.
CreateFolderRequest
Payload for POST /api/folders.
CurrentUser
Immutable snapshot of the authenticated caller extracted from the OIDC access token, exposing the identity and realm roles that the RBAC and service layers use to make authorization decisions.
DmsApplication
Spring Boot entry point for the DMS backend.
DocumentController
REST endpoints for the document lifecycle under /api/documents: upload, metadata retrieval and update, binary download, deletion, and per-document permission management.
DocumentMetadataResponse
Full metadata view of a document returned by the document-detail endpoint.
DocumentRecord
Persistent entity for an uploaded document, stored in the MongoDB documents collection.
DocumentRepository
MongoDB repository for DocumentRecord entities, providing lookups by EAP number, folder, and OCR status used across the document and OCR services.
DocumentService
Core document lifecycle service: uploading files (stored in GridFS with an allocated EAP number), reading metadata, downloading content, replacing content, updating metadata, soft-deleting, and reading/updating per-document permissions.
DocumentService.DownloadPayload
Carries a downloadable document's binary resource with its content type and file name.
DocumentSummary
Compact document view for list displays (e.g. folder contents): identity, title, EAP number, type, OCR/document status and upload date.
DocumentUploadResponse
Response returned after a successful document upload: the new document id, its overall status and the initial ocrStatus of the text-extraction job that was queued.
EapNumberService
Allocates and validates EAP numbers of the form CATEGORY-DEPARTMENT-YEAR-SEQUENCE.
EapSequence
Counter document backing EAP-number generation, stored in the MongoDB eap_sequences collection.
Folder
Persistent entity for a folder in the document hierarchy, stored in the MongoDB folders collection.
FolderAccess
The set of permission flags granted by a FolderAcl: read, create, update, delete and managePermissions.
FolderAcl
Access-control list embedded in a Folder (and in DocumentRecord).
FolderController
REST endpoints for browsing and managing the folder hierarchy under /api/folders.
FolderPage
A single page of folder listings.
FolderRepository
MongoDB repository for Folder entities, supporting path- and parent-based lookups over the materialized-path folder tree.
FolderResponse
Full view of a folder document, returned when a folder is created.
FolderService
Manages the folder tree: viewing, listing, creating, renaming/moving, and deleting folders.
FolderSummary
Compact folder view for list displays (subfolder listings, breadcrumbs): identity, name and full path.
FolderViewResponse
Aggregated payload for opening a folder: the folder itself, its breadcrumb trail, its immediate subfolders and the documents it contains.
GlobalExceptionHandler
Application-wide REST exception handler that converts thrown exceptions into RFC 7807 ProblemDetail responses, keeping error output consistent across all controllers.
HealthController
Minimal liveness endpoint used by container and load-balancer health probes.
KeycloakAdminService
Read-only gateway to the Keycloak Admin REST API.
KeycloakAdminService.DirectorySnapshot
Immutable pairing of the realm's DMS users and roles returned by a directory load.
MetadataUpdateRequest
Request payload for editing a document's descriptive metadata (title, description and document type) via the metadata-update endpoint.
OcrAdminService
Administrative view over the OCR processing queue.
OcrJobResponse
View of a document's OCR/text-extraction job for the admin OCR monitoring endpoint: the source document identity plus job state — ocrStatus, extractionMethod, retryCount and any ocrError.
OpenApiConfig
Configures the OpenAPI 3 document that springdoc serves at /v3/api-docs and renders as Swagger UI at /swagger-ui.html.

The kinds of access that can be requested on a document or folder.

SearchService
Document search with RBAC enforced at query time.
SecurityConfig
Central Spring Security configuration for the DMS backend.
